toggle.label: Coaching tips
toggle.hint: Screen explanations, pointers on important actions and suggestions for what to do next. Turn them off for a leaner interface.

idle.brokenVehicle: {callSign} is out of service with a breakdown.
idle.expiringCandidate: A candidate ({role}) is about to expire.
idle.affordableUpgrade: You can now afford a new {vehicle}.

personnel.title: Personnel
personnel.body: Here you hire, train and organise your stations’ operators into teams: without a crew a vehicle cannot leave.
personnel.tip1: Quick hires cover an emergency; teams give steady bonuses.
personnel.tip2: A fatigued operator can be sent to rest from the Roster tab.

medical.title: Patients
medical.body: Every patient needs to be assessed, stabilised and transported to a hospital: unmet needs slow down closing the case.
medical.tip1: Triage colour shows urgency: red cases come first.
medical.tip2: The recommended hospital is already selected: one tap is enough, the manual choice is optional.

inventory.title: Warehouse
inventory.body: Every station uses up consumables on missions: here you check stock levels and order supplies.
inventory.tip1: A stock line below the minimum blocks using that capability on a mission.
inventory.tip2: An urgent order arrives sooner but costs more.

maintenance.title: Workshop
maintenance.body: Vehicles wear down with missions: here you see their health, book maintenance and follow recovery after a breakdown.
maintenance.tip1: A vehicle in critical condition risks breaking down while in service.
maintenance.tip2: A breakdown on the road starts its own recovery: follow its progress here.

shop.title: New service: {family}
shop.body: This is where you buy this service’s vehicles and choose which station receives them.
shop.tip1: A locked vehicle shows the level or station you need to unlock it.
shop.tip2: You can change the delivery station from the menu above, if you have more than one compatible one.

world.title: World
world.body: Local weather, time of day and traffic affect your vehicles’ travel times in real time.
world.tip1: Active road closures reroute vehicles: tap one to see it on the map.
world.tip2: Heavy traffic slows arrivals down: plan extra margin during peak hours.

facilities.title: Stations
facilities.body: Here you see your stations, their available space and the upgrades you can build.
facilities.tip1: Each upgrade raises one specific capacity: vehicles, personnel or storage.
facilities.tip2: A new station elsewhere on the map cuts arrival times in that area.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.body: The list of every vehicle you own, its status and its home station.
fleet.tip1: You can transfer a vehicle to another compatible station from its transfer icon.
fleet.tip2: Tap a vehicle to open it on the map and see its details.

progression.title: Career
progression.body: Level, experience, reputation and milestones: here you see what levelling up unlocks.
progression.tip1: Every mission resolved well raises reputation, which also raises the coverage stipend.
progression.tip2: Milestones pay a one-off reward when you complete them.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Important alerts about your career land here: vehicles, personnel, stations and economy.
notifications.tip1: Tap a notification to jump straight to what it refers to.
notifications.tip2: You can filter by category with the buttons at the top.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.body: Staff-only tools: users, careers, incidents, configuration and system monitoring.
admin.tip1: Every action here is recorded in the audit log.
admin.tip2: The banner at the top always shows which environment you are on: check it before acting.

crewInsufficient.title: Not enough crew
crewInsufficient.body: This vehicle cannot leave without enough operators. Hire more operators to be able to use it.

hospitalTransport.title: Hospital transport
hospitalTransport.body: The recommended hospital is already selected: one tap starts the transport, or pick another one.

lockedFamily.title: Service not unlocked yet
lockedFamily.body: This service unlocks at a higher career level: keep resolving missions to reach it.

vehicleBreakdown.title: Breakdown in progress
vehicleBreakdown.body: This vehicle has broken down and is out of service: follow the recovery and repair times here.

lowStock.title: Running low on supplies
lowStock.body: A stock line below the minimum can block using that capability on a mission: order more supplies.

coverageStipend.title: Coverage and stipend
coverageStipend.body: Every period you receive a stipend computed from territory coverage and your reputation: here is how it is worked out.
